posts.title: How to get three points removed from your Idaho driving record
posts.description: Idaho removes three points from your record when you complete an approved defensive driving course, once every three years. The citation has to be paid first, and you send ITD the certificate yourself. Here is the whole process.

faq.q: How many points does an Idaho defensive driving course remove?
faq.a: Three, once every three years, under IDAPA 39.02.71.

faq.q: Do I have to pay the ticket first?
faq.a: Yes. ITD applies the reduction only after any outstanding citation is paid.

faq.q: Does the course get the ticket dropped?
faq.a: No. Idaho has no traffic-school program that voids a citation. The conviction records; the course removes three points.

sources.name: IDAPA 39.02.71 — Rules Governing Driver's License Point Reduction

posts.content:
**Short answer:** Complete an Idaho-approved defensive driving course, pay any outstanding citation, and send your certificate to the Idaho Transportation Department. ITD removes three points from your record. You can do this once every three years. The conviction itself stays on the record, and no Idaho course voids a ticket.

## The rule

IDAPA 39.02.71 is Idaho's rule for point reduction through defensive driving. Section 400 provides that three points may be removed from a driver's record on completion of an approved course, and that points may be removed this way only once every three years. Section 550 sets the course at a minimum of six hours.

## Step by step

### 1. Check that you are eligible

You need points on your Idaho record and no reduction in the past three years. If you used one in 2024, you wait until 2027.

### 2. Pay the citation

ITD applies the reduction only after any outstanding citation is paid. If the ticket is still open, close it first.

### 3. Take an approved six-hour course

ITD keeps the list of approved providers. [Our course](/idaho) is six hours, $24.99, self-paced, with no quizzes and a 25-question final exam you can retake as often as you need. There is no state deadline.

### 4. Send ITD your certificate

Email it to ddc@itd.idaho.gov or mail it to ITD DMV, PO Box 7129, Boise, ID 83707-1129. Idaho has no provider reporting system; this step is yours. Allow a couple of weeks and then check your record.

## What the reduction does and does not do

It removes three points. It does not remove the conviction, it does not refund the fine, and it does not stop your insurer from seeing the violation. If you are close to a suspension threshold, three points is real headroom. If you were hoping to make the ticket disappear, Idaho does not offer that.

## Drivers 55 and older

Some Idaho insurers reduce premiums for drivers 55 and older who complete a defensive driving course. Whether this course qualifies, and by how much, is your insurer's decision. Call them before you enroll if that is your reason.

posts.title: How Idaho's point system works: the suspension thresholds and the three-point reduction
posts.description: Idaho suspends a license at 12 points in 12 months. The suspension gets longer at 18 and 24. An approved course removes three points once every three years. The whole system in one place.

faq.q: How many points suspends an Idaho license?
faq.a: Twelve or more points in any twelve-month period triggers a suspension. Idaho Code 49-326 sets the schedule; ITD's guidance is 30 days at 12 to 17 points, 60 days at 18 to 23, and 90 days at 24 or more.

faq.q: How long do points stay on an Idaho record?
faq.a: Points count toward suspension for twelve months from the violation date. The conviction itself remains on the record longer.

faq.q: Can a course prevent the suspension?
faq.a: It can help if it brings you under the threshold before the suspension is imposed. Once the suspension is in effect the course does not shorten it.

posts.content:
**Short answer:** Idaho assigns one to four points to most moving violations. Twelve or more points within twelve months triggers a suspension. ITD's published schedule is 30 days for 12 to 17 points, 60 days for 18 to 23, and 90 days for 24 or more. An approved six-hour defensive driving course removes three points, once every three years, after any citation is paid.

## How points accumulate

Most moving violations carry one to four points, with speeding scaled by how far over the limit you were. Points count toward the suspension threshold for twelve months from the date of the violation. The conviction stays on your record longer than the points count.

## The suspension schedule

| Points in 12 months | Suspension |
|---|---|
| 12 to 17 | 30 days |
| 18 to 23 | 60 days |
| 24 or more | 90 days |

ITD sends notice before imposing the suspension. Confirm your current total against your own record before relying on any table, including this one.

## The three-point reduction

IDAPA 39.02.71 lets ITD remove three points when you complete an approved course. Once every three years, only after any outstanding citation is paid, and it does not touch the conviction itself. [Our course](/idaho) is six hours and $24.99. We wrote up the process in [how to get three points removed](/idaho/blog/how-to-get-3-points-removed-idaho-driving-record).

## When the course helps most

At nine to eleven points, three points off is the difference between a warning and a 30-day suspension the next time you are cited. At twelve or more, the course does not shorten a suspension already imposed. Take it early.

## What to do today

1. Request your driving record from ITD and count the points inside the last twelve months.
2. Pay any open citation.
3. Take an approved course and email ITD the certificate. Three points off, once every three years.
